title: Patient Payment Plans Calendar Terms: Offer, Acceptance and Due Day
content:
These are the calendar terms of **Patient Payment Plans** as they appear in the plan agreement: how long an offer stays open, the ways a patient may accept it, when the written agreement is sent, where installment 1 may fall, the range of due days and how many times the due day may be changed.

## Offer and acceptance

| Term | Acceptance window (calendar days after the offer) | Ways the patient may accept | Written agreement sent within (business days after acceptance) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Payment Plan | 10 | patient-portal e-signature; recorded phone consent | 2 |
| 6-Month Payment Plan | 10 | patient-portal e-signature; recorded phone consent | 2 |
| 9-Month Payment Plan | 10 | patient-portal e-signature; recorded phone consent; signed mail-in form | 2 |
| 12-Month Payment Plan | 10 | patient-portal e-signature; recorded phone consent; signed mail-in form | 2 |
| 18-Month Payment Plan | 10 | patient-portal e-signature; recorded phone consent; signed mail-in form | 2 |
| 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | 14 | patient-portal e-signature; signed mail-in form | 2 |

The 24-Month Extended Payment Plan cannot be accepted by recorded phone consent, and the 3-Month and 6-Month terms cannot be accepted by signed mail-in form.

## Installment calendar

| Term | Days to installment 1 (calendar days, at least) | Installment 1 no later than (calendar days after the offer date) | Earliest due day of the month | Latest due day of the month | Due-day changes allowed over the life of the plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Payment Plan | 30 | 45 | 1 | 28 | 1 |
| 6-Month Payment Plan | 30 | 45 | 1 | 28 | 1 |
| 9-Month Payment Plan | 30 | 45 | 1 | 28 | 1 |
| 12-Month Payment Plan | 30 | 45 | 1 | 28 | 1 |
| 18-Month Payment Plan | 30 | 45 | 1 | 28 | 1 |
| 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | 30 | 45 | 1 | 28 | 2 |

- **Days to installment 1** is the number of calendar days that must pass before the first regular installment falls; installment 1 is moved forward to the patient's chosen due day.
- **Installment 1 no later than** is the number of calendar days after the offer date within which the first installment must fall.
- **Earliest and latest due day** bound the day of the month the patient may choose as the due day: any day from the 1st to the 28th. The 29th, 30th and 31st cannot be chosen on any term.
- **Due-day changes allowed** is the number of times the monthly due day may be changed over the whole life of one plan: once on every term except the 24-Month Extended Payment Plan, which allows two changes.
